about: Session deadline: the agent waits on a long job; at the deadline it is woken once to wrap up, the session ends when that turn returns, and its whole process tree is reaped.

turns.ipython:
jobs.submit('sleep 600', name='long')
jobs.submit('sleep 600 & sleep 600; wait', name='tree')
jobs.wait('long', wake_after='10m')

turns.text: Wrapping up: long and tree are still running and will be stopped.
